dragon_ability.dragonsurvival.annihilati:
Activate Annihilation Moment, forsake survivability and fully unleash offensive output.

■ Bonuses: Strength, Haste, Swiftness, Mineral Furnace (consumes off-hand mineral for bonus damage), Nano-Repair (heal on attack), Frame Stripping (ignores invincibility frames), True Damage Fission (converts part of damage to true damage).

■ Costs: Convert health to shield, consume saturation per second, reduce armor.

■ Special: Creature Highlight (scan marking), Reverse Entropy Amplification (gain attack based on missing health), Calamity Interception (when taking damage exceeding a certain percentage of max health, the excess is negated).

dragon_ability.dragonsurvival.random_fau:
Every so often, there is a chance to trigger a random malfunction. Effects include:

■ Fault 1: Joint Jamming – grants Slowness and Mining Fatigue

■ Fault 2: Blurred Vision – grants Blindness

■ Fault 3: System Reboot – grants Nausea

■ Fault 4: Shield Overload – grants Resistance but also Weakness

■ Fault 5: Core Overheat – grants Weakness and reduces armor

annihilator_type_a.configuration.title: %s Configuration
annihilator_type_a.configuration.mark_ad: Whether the orbital beam of Mark Adjudication destroys blocks. When off it still deals its damage and plays every effect, but leaves the terrain untouched: no crater under the impact and no shaft burned through the ceiling above it.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.ring.en: Draw the machined dial around every entity affected by the annihilation moment.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.ring.vi: Affected entities farther away than this, in blocks, are not drawn.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.ring.fo: Scale the dial and its sparks with the entity's body height, measured against one block. Taller entities get a proportionally larger ring, shorter ones a smaller one.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.ring.si: Overall size multiplier applied on top of the body scaling, 0.25 - 4.0.
How strongly the body height is followed, 0.0 - 1.0. 1.0 scales in proportion to the height measured against one block; lower values damp the change in either direction.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.ring.ma: Hard cap on the final ring scale, 0.35 - 4.0. Cost grows with the square of this: going from 4.0 down to 2.5 removes about 60% of the blended pixels the dial covers, which matters because the dial is four large additive quads.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.ring.di: Draw fewer dial layers for distant rings: past 24 blocks the encoder and index dials are only a few pixels across, and past 40 only the outer gear is drawn.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.ring.cu: Skip rings whose area lies entirely outside the view frustum.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.ena: Draw the annihilation moment HUD panels.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.dec: Draw the decorative corner brackets and the sweeping highlight.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.sel: Only show the left self-status panel while the annihilation moment is active. Set to false to keep your own attributes on screen at all times. Either way the panel is exclusive to the mechanical dragon - it is identified by that species' permanent random fault marker - so no other species and no human ever sees it.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.tar: Show the right target panel for the creature under the crosshair.

Only show the right target panel while the annihilation moment is active. Set to false to keep it up whenever something is targeted. Either way the panel is exclusive to the mechanical dragon, so no other species and no human ever sees it.
Include the target's armour and attack damage in the right panel.
Include the target's active effects in the right panel.
How far, in blocks, the crosshair looks for a creature to inspect, 4 - 64.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.fra: Draw the full-screen visor frame while the annihilation moment is running.
How far the frame sits in from the left and right edges, as a fraction, 0.0 - 0.45.
How far it sits in from the top and bottom edges, 0.0 - 0.45.
Length of the diagonal corner cuts, as a fraction of the screen height, 0.0 - 0.60. Larger values read more like a hexagon than a box.
Opacity of the frame's main contour, 0.0 - 1.0.
Accent colour of the frame, as a hex RGB string such as 4FD8FF. The species' official primary colour is 66CCFF.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.top: Horizontal offset of the top ability panel, in GUI pixels.
Vertical offset of the top ability panel, in GUI pixels.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.lef: Horizontal offset of the left self-status panel, in GUI pixels.
Vertical offset of the left self-status panel, in GUI pixels.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.hud.rig: Horizontal offset of the right target panel, in GUI pixels.
Vertical offset of the right target panel, in GUI pixels.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.debug.t: Log the average cost of each effect renderer once a second, to the game log. Use it to tell which part is responsible for a frame rate drop.
annihilator_type_a.configuration.lightni: Show the WARNING: LIGHTNING STORM CREATED banner the moment the storm is released. An interrupted cast never reaches that point, so it shows nothing.
Show the column of scrolling values down the left of the screen while the storm charges.
